title: SIDESTORY: WHO IS REAL OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: WHO IS REAL OPEN
EVENT DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Who Is Real event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Leave From Yourself] Duration: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Come to Yourself] Duration: August 6, 2021, 16:00 (UTC-7) – August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[ASK YOUSELF]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Ask Yourself] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Lava the Purgatory, Tan-Ch'ing Court Furniture (Pieces), Dusk Inksticks.
[ANSWER YOURSELF]
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Dusk Inksticks by clearing event stages and Ask Yourself missions. Dusk Inksticks can be used to redeem items from Answer Yourself.
MAIN REWARDS: Lava the Purgatory's Token, Tan-Ch'ing Court Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Battle Record, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING OPEN – HIDDEN MOON
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Exclusive Headhunting, "Hidden Moon", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Dusk [Limited] / Saga (70% in 6* Operators)
★★★★★: Mr. Nothing (50% in 5* Operators)
★★★★★★: Nian [Limited] (Rate up in the rest 30% in 6* Operators)
NOTE:
"Hidden Moon" belongs to "Limited Headhunting: Festival"
"Limited Headhunting: Festival" is "Limited Headhunting"
Limited Operator Dusk can ONLY be obtained from "Limited Headhunting: Festival" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
03 LIMITED-TIME LOG-IN EVENT: HIDDEN MOON OPEN
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [ Tide on Sunset Headhunting Permit] * 1 as login reward. During the event, players can do one free roll in "Hidden Moon" every day.
NOTE:
[Tide on Sunset Headhunting Permit] can only be used in Exclusive Headhunting “Hidden Moon”
This login reward only can be obtained once for each account
[Tide on Sunset Headhunting Permit] will be expired at August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
The free roll will be refreshed at 04:00 everyday.
The unused free roll chance will be refreshed at 04:00 each day and thus cannot be cumulated.
04 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Hidden Moon”.
★★★★★★: Dusk [Limited] / Saga
★★★★★: Mr. Nothing
NOTE:
New Limited Operator Dusk can ONLY be obtained from "Limited Headhunting: Festival".
Operator Lava the Purgatory is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Who Is Real.
Operator Lava the Purgatory is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
New Operator Mr. Nothing and Saga will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Lava the Purgatory, Mr. Nothing, Saga and Dusk will gain more trust during July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
05 LUNGMEN LUCKY STRIPS OPEN
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 13, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Lungmen Lucky Strips after daily login. Between the Lucky Stirps you picked, the one with the higher amount
of Orundum will be the final daily reward. Players need to use all trials to get the reward.
NOTE:
There are 14 days at most for players to pick Lucky Strips.
Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Lucky Strips:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800.
If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated,
players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
06 SPECIAL IN-GAME PRESENTS
DURATION: July 30, 2021 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can receive presents through in-game mails from different Operators.
NOTE:
Please refer to the in-game mails for the actual contents and schedule of the gifts.
Each in-game mail will be valid to claim within 7 days. Please claim these mails in time.
07 SNOWY SURPRISE SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: August 6, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) – August 27, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 15 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Auspiciously Patterned Fan * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 2: Orundum * 300, LMD * 30000
Day 3: Originite Prime * 1, Vanguard Chip * 2
Day 4: Chip Catalyst * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 5: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Caster Chip * 2
Day 6: Orundum * 300, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 7: Bunny Drum Toy * 1, Skill Summary - 2 * 15
Day 8: Originite Prime * 2, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 9: Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 10: Orundum * 300, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 11: Originite Prime * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 12: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Day 13: 0011 Series - Tremble Cold for Whisperain * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 14: Headhunting Permit * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 10
Day 15: Twisted Treelamp * 1, LMD * 30000
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will expire at August 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
08 0011 COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
0011 Collection – Unfettered Freedom for Nian
0011 Collection – Doctor of Faces for Aak
0011 Collection – Just a Driver for Hung
09 RHODES ISLAND RESOURCE PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, Rhodes Island Resource Pack will be available at Store for a limited-time.
[ RHODES ISLAND RESOURCE PACK]

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 200000, Chip Catalyst * 4, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Frontline Battle Record * 50, Skill Summary – 3 * 20, Skill Summary – 2 * 30
[ RHODES ISLAND SPECIAL PACK]
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 51, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, Furniture Part * 1000, Orundum * 2100
[ RHODES ISLAND HEADHUNTING PACK]
DETAILS: Players need to select one of the following customized options when purchasing:
Type-α Headhunting Permit: (Guaranteed 6-star Operator include one of the follows: Weedy, Thorns, Magallan)
Type-β Headhunting Permit: (Guaranteed 6-star Operator include one of the follows: Rosa, Bagpipe, Hellagur)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit: (Guaranteed 6-star Operator include one of the follows: Schwarz, Suzuran, Phantom)
NOTE:
You may select only one of the special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits to purchase. You cannot change your decision after purchasing.
While performing any rolls in the special Headhunting, rolls that do not give a 6* Operator will not count towards the 6* protection mechanism, nor will it affect your
accumulated roll count on "Standard Headhunting." Rates are also not affected by your accumulated roll count on "Standard Headhunting."

When performing this special headhunting, you are guaranteed to receive a 6* Operator from the corresponding pool when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6* Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the special Headhunting pool chosen.
You may only use the special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, the special Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.

The special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires. If not used by the expiration date, the special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Except a guaranteed 6* Operator, the odds of obtaining different operators are as follows:
10 NEW FURNITURE SET – TAN-CH ’ ING COURT
DURATION: July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Tan-Ch'ing Court, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Who Is Real event rewards and redeem in Answer Yourself (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from July 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 20, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
